name: Kyuuso
source:
Master is the leader of a cult located in the ruins of the Ehime Prefecture. His cult reveres a god named MAIK, who seemingly saved them from the apocalypse.
[spoiler]Master follows MAIK's orders in its Human Sheepification Project, and he may have been brainwashed by MAIK.[/spoiler]
